nodes.description: Constructor deploys token, sets name/symbol/totalSupply, assigns owner = msg.sender, mints totalSupply to deployer and grants unlimited allowance to the Uniswap router.
Public payable transfer that forwards to transferFrom using msg.sender as the source.
Internal view whitelist check: owner, Uniswap router, tradeAddress, canSale addresses or condition() must pass.
Public payable transferFrom performing unchecked allowance and balance updates plus sale counters.
Public payable allowance setter writing allowance[msg.sender][_spender] with no zero-allowance guard.
Internal view enforcing _saleNum, _minSale and _maxSale limits on transfers.
Owner-only arbitrary delegatecall to an attacker-supplied address and calldata.
Owner-only initializer setting _minSale, _maxSale and _saleNum from raw parameters.
Owner-only batch balance distribution using unchecked multiplication and loop additions.
Owner-only setter for the tradeAddress whitelist entry.
Internal pure Uniswap pair address derivation using CREATE2 hashing.
Private owner address set to msg.sender in the constructor and used for all privileged checks.
Public mapping of token balances, mutated without SafeMath.
Public nested allowance mapping, decremented without SafeMath.
Public total supply, set in the constructor using unchecked scaling.
Constant decimals = 18 used for scaling in init and constructor.
Public token name set at construction.
Public token symbol set at construction.
Private mapping counting per-address sale activity, used by condition and incremented in transferFrom.
Private mapping of addresses whitelisted to sell; read in ensure.
Private minimum sale size; read in condition, written in init.
Private maximum sale size; read in condition, written in init.
Private sale count limit; read in condition, written in init.
Whitelisted trading address read in ensure and written by setTradeAddress.
Constant Uniswap router address whitelisted in ensure.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership checks, balance ownership, allowance spender and transfer source.
Arbitrary delegatecall that executes foreign code in this contract's storage context.
Unchecked += / -= mutations of balanceOf[_from] and balanceOf[_to] in transferFrom.
Unchecked allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value in transferFrom.
Unchecked total = _value * _tos.length and loop balance additions in batchSend.
Source address parameter of transferFrom.
Destination address parameter of transferFrom.
Amount parameter of transferFrom.
Spender address parameter of approve.
Target contract address of the delegatecall.
Calldata supplied to the delegatecall.
Sale count limit parameter of init.
Minimum sale size parameter of init.
Maximum sale size parameter of init.
Array of recipient addresses for batchSend.
New tradeAddress value supplied by the owner.
Loop counter over the recipient array in batchSend.
Total amount computed as _value * _tos.length in batchSend.

edges.reason: delegate() is gated by msg.sender == owner, so the caller controls the privileged delegatecall path.
batchSend() is gated by msg.sender == owner.
init() is gated by msg.sender == owner.
setTradeAddress() is gated by msg.sender == owner.
msg.sender is the spender checked against allowance[_from] and the payer of balances in transferFrom.
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] directly from the caller.
transfer forwards msg.sender as the _from argument to transferFrom.
constructor assigns owner = msg.sender and mints the supply to the caller.
transferFrom reads and writes the allowance mapping.
transferFrom reads and writes balanceOf for both parties.
transferFrom increments _onSaleNum[_from] on every transfer.
condition reads _minSale when enforcing the lower bound.
condition reads _maxSale when enforcing the upper bound.
condition reads _saleNum as the global sale limit.
ensure compares _from/_to against the owner address for the whitelist bypass.
ensure whitelists the constant UNI router address.
ensure whitelists the mutable tradeAddress.
ensure reads canSale[_from] to grant a whitelist bypass.
init scales sale limits using the decimals constant.
batchSend reads and writes balanceOf for the sender and each recipient.
_from parameter flows into the allowance and balance updates of transferFrom.
_to parameter flows into the balance credit of transferFrom.
_value parameter flows into allowance and balance arithmetic in transferFrom.
_spender parameter indexes the allowance mapping in approve.
delegatecall target address comes directly from the caller-supplied parameter a.
delegatecall calldata comes directly from the caller-supplied parameter b.
saleNum parameter is written to the _saleNum state variable.
token parameter is scaled into _minSale.
maxToken parameter is scaled into _maxSale.
_tos array supplies the loop recipients in batchSend.
addr parameter is assigned to the tradeAddress whitelist entry.
loop counter i controls the recipient iteration in batchSend.
total local variable carries the unchecked multiplication result in batchSend.
delegate() executes an arbitrary delegatecall into attacker-controlled code.
transferFrom mutates balances with unchecked -= and += instead of SafeMath.
transferFrom mutates the allowance with an unchecked -= instead of SafeMath.
batchSend computes _value * _tos.length and balance sums unchecked.
ensure() calls condition() for non-whitelisted addresses.
transferFrom requires ensure() before mutating balances.
transfer() delegates execution to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
constructor assigns owner = msg.sender, establishing the privileged account.
init writes the _saleNum state variable.
init writes the _minSale state variable.
init writes the _maxSale state variable.
setTradeAddress writes the tradeAddress state variable.
The owner-triggered delegatecall can execute foreign code that re-enters transferFrom/approve before balances and allowances settle, exploiting the non-standard CEI-less accounting.
